pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: EU-prod 502 spike — 9m agg rate up 4x, affected p50/p95 increased. Alert link: https://monitoring.example.com/alerts/8743

Anya K: fyi i'm running to the airport, gate just opened. i'm primary for the next ~2.5h but can't reliably respond. can someone pick up primary? there's an active pager from the EU 502s. paging/ops runbook is below.

Maya R: i can step in as primary unless someone else wants it. i have the creds. will need brief handoff.

Jules P: i can shadow as backup for the window — i'll stay on pager too. can you drop the runbook snippet?

Anya K: thx maya. quick handoff checklist:
- confirm primary switch in rotation tracker
- ensure pager escalation still goes to new primary
- share any in-progress mitigation (i already tried rolling the EU inference pool once)
- note any customer tickets (so far 7 502 reports, mostly EU-west)

Anya K: runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/eu-502-spike
snippet (from runbook):
```
# quick mitigations
kubectl scale deployment inference-eu --replicas=20 -n redwood-prod
# flush prefix cache for suspected hot model
redwoodctl cache flush --region eu --model gpt-small-v2
# fallback route
redwoodctl route set --service inference --fallback-model gpt-small-quant --region eu
```

Anya K: also i'm seeing steady 502s from a subset of hosts (ip range 10.22.x.x) — might be worker oom or kernel issue. i triggered a rolling restart on two nodes earlier: `kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-worker -n redwood-prod --selector=zone=eu-west`

Kevin L: tagging @Maya R to confirm. maya — do you want me to take secondary and handle the escalation path? i can also re-run the node checks.

Maya R: yes ok i'll take primary. kevin please be secondary/monitor. jules thanks for shadowing.

Maya R: doing quick validation steps now:
1) confirm pager target -> looks like pager config still points at oncall rotation service. i'll run the quick check: `pagerctl whoami --rotation inference-primary`
2) verify routing policy for eu region -> `redwoodctl route get --service inference --region eu`

Maya R: pagerctl output: current-primary = Anya K, rotation-id = inference-primary, this will be reassigned in ~30s when i flip.

Maya R: flipping rotation to me now.

pagerbot: action=rotation-update rotation=inference-primary old=Anya K new=Maya R ts=1748601290

Maya R: confirmed - pager shows me as primary. watching alerts.

Jules P: mirrored my terminal and logs. seeing increased 5xx from two hosts: redwood-worker-eu-12 and -14. open to draining them if needed.

Kevin L: if nodes are flaky i'll drain and cordon then let infra auto-replace. drain cmd i use: `kubectl drain redwood-worker-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Maya R: i'm running the drain on -12 now. i'll keep -14 warm. also scaling inference-eu up + routing fallback as in runbook.

ops-bot: NOTE: rotation update recorded in audit log by Maya R. runbook used: eu-502-spike.

Anya K: thanks everyone, appreciate the handoff — i'll be offline for takeoff, will check in once landed.

Maya R: quick customer-impact note for the incident timeline: customer-facing errors ~09:12-09:48 for subset of EU users, partial mitigation started 09:22 (scale+fallback), full stabilization at 09:46. i'll file a short post-incident note and tag support.

Jules P: thx — i'll leave a sticky in the runbook with the node ids and steps we ran.

Kevin L: confirmed i'm watching metrics and will escalate to infra if node replacement doesn't clear errors in 15m.

Maya R: all good, rotation tracker updated: https://rotations.redwood/rotations/inference-primary?window=2026-03

pagerbot: reminder: if primary unresponsive for 2m escalation -> secondary (Kevin L) -> ops manager -> pager to duty_ops.

Maya R: closing loop — handoff done, primary now Maya R, secondary Kevin L, shadow Jules P. leaving short runbook note now. :white_check_mark:

Anya K: cheers, safe flight :)
